Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 36, "heading": "CHAPTER 34. MY AUNT ASTONISHES ME", "previous_rows": [], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 34, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u036-h", "tag": "h2", "role": "heading", "text": "CHAPTER 34. MY AUNT ASTONISHES ME", "sha256": "c1ce3035137399a0458dab67336d97378df9c43ccc179dbf6d470aecc7eb4089", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/h2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0001", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I wrote to Agnes as soon as Dora and I were engaged. I wrote her a long letter, in which I tried to make her comprehend how blest I was, and what a darling Dora was. I entreated Agnes not to regard this as a thoughtless passion which could ever yield to any other, or had the least resemblance to the boyish fancies that we used to joke about. I assured her that its profundity was quite unfathomable, and expressed my belief that nothing like it had ever been known.", "sha256": "008ee6cbba61c518e4df83ae4469b64fc5a26f142b7601a45272aef1ee1785c5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[1]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0002", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Somehow, as I wrote to Agnes on a fine evening by my open window, and the remembrance of her clear calm eyes and gentle face came stealing over me, it shed such a peaceful influence upon the hurry and agitation in which I had been living lately, and of which my very happiness partook in some degree, that it soothed me into tears. I remember that I sat resting my head upon my hand, when the letter was half done, cherishing a general fancy as if Agnes were one of the elements of my natural home. As if, in the retirement of the house made almost sacred to me by her presence, Dora and I must be happier than anywhere. As if, in love, joy, sorrow, hope, or disappointment; in all emotions; my heart turned naturally there, and found its refuge and best friend.", "sha256": "86294707f52fd26f60e3a10626ee3b4283b1010d4ca20ab82b7a6a1e03fae061", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[2]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0003", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Of Steerforth I said nothing. I only told her there had been sad grief at Yarmouth, on account of Emily’s flight; and that on me it made a double wound, by reason of the circumstances attending it. I knew how quick she always was to divine the truth, and that she would never be the first to breathe his name.", "sha256": "4a202aad660b5106b85900ebbe37365f47f762517a8137e8d15f05fb6aacf4f5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[3]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0004", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "To this letter, I received an answer by return of post. As I read it, I seemed to hear Agnes speaking to me. It was like her cordial voice in my ears. What can I say more!", "sha256": "23c19bb7d40ccab1eac970abab640ced103b6d56095ccbf946a7e4d6a2a534bc", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[4]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0005", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "While I had been away from home lately, Traddles had called twice or thrice. Finding Peggotty within, and being informed by Peggotty (who always volunteered that information to whomsoever would receive it), that she was my old nurse, he had established a good-humoured acquaintance with her, and had stayed to have a little chat with her about me. So Peggotty said; but I am afraid the chat was all on her own side, and of immoderate length, as she was very difficult indeed to stop, God bless her! when she had me for her theme.", "sha256": "daee968270269560eb47848945ebfa37b5891d6aaf264ba149cc8eceb5fdcf18", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[5]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0006", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "This reminds me, not only that I expected Traddles on a certain afternoon of his own appointing, which was now come, but that Mrs. Crupp had resigned everything appertaining to her office (the salary excepted) until Peggotty should cease to present herself. Mrs. Crupp, after holding divers conversations respecting Peggotty, in a very high-pitched voice, on the staircase—with some invisible Familiar it would appear, for corporeally speaking she was quite alone at those times—addressed a letter to me, developing her views. Beginning it with that statement of universal application, which fitted every occurrence of her life, namely, that she was a mother herself, she went on to inform me that she had once seen very different days, but that at all periods of her existence she had had a constitutional objection to spies, intruders, and informers. She named no names, she said; let them the cap fitted, wear it; but spies, intruders, and informers, especially in widders’ weeds (this clause was underlined), she had ever accustomed herself to look down upon. If a gentleman was the victim of spies, intruders, and informers (but still naming no names), that was his own pleasure. He had a right to please himself; so let him do. All that she, Mrs. Crupp, stipulated for, was, that she should not be ‘brought in contract’ with such persons. Therefore she begged to be excused from any further attendance on the top set, until things were as they formerly was, and as they could be wished to be; and further mentioned that her little book would be found upon the breakfast-table every Saturday morning, when she requested an immediate settlement of the same, with the benevolent view of saving trouble ‘and an ill-conwenience’ to all parties.", "sha256": "6015cb171b94b6855e7a790a58620974c470270eab3d3da307730ff6295d6e08", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[6]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0007", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "After this, Mrs. Crupp confined herself to making pitfalls on the stairs, principally with pitchers, and endeavouring to delude Peggotty into breaking her legs. I found it rather harassing to live in this state of siege, but was too much afraid of Mrs. Crupp to see any way out of it.", "sha256": "91285e86396d030998b1f6f46799e1f608344ae6af137a98f3f305c8661f5f27", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[7]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0008", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My dear Copperfield,’ cried Traddles, punctually appearing at my door, in spite of all these obstacles, ‘how do you do?’", "sha256": "122d033fd618736fea041427ba6479b2a6363dc8296190c63aa7d02ee3cb478e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[8]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0009", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My dear Traddles,’ said I, ‘I am delighted to see you at last, and very sorry I have not been at home before. But I have been so much engaged—’", "sha256": "7ebc148eba1deca6359b29886997b741189a2309cd8653ec039a453824bbf470", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[9]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0010", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes, yes, I know,’ said Traddles, ‘of course. Yours lives in London, I think.’", "sha256": "3c9b0c582e8208e5304e790ac0bd2746907cf1cc9ba98ef95775838beacd6f2d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[10]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0011", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What did you say?’", "sha256": "7308084e34bb5a11525c0491cbacfeb15bdc9aab53893500690ba0f1e31f806d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[11]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0012", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘She—excuse me—Miss D., you know,’ said Traddles, colouring in his great delicacy, ‘lives in London, I believe?’", "sha256": "f41300fbe4dfd22d7b88f29a4bd9f207cd847573516b78bb8a230020b460feaf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[12]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0013", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh yes. Near London.’", "sha256": "91d0d1e27d55d23c504fd3028f327463e71784e5c4f9f6085618a33f10bb62cf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[13]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0014", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Mine, perhaps you recollect,’ said Traddles, with a serious look, ‘lives down in Devonshire—one of ten. Consequently, I am not so much engaged as you—in that sense.’", "sha256": "e87b54277f380ebad3f59a811b37d6dca0d64f28df3fa657694f3a74e425ebc4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[14]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0015", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I wonder you can bear,’ I returned, ‘to see her so seldom.’", "sha256": "82e62fa39467fc3a25ac4aa585ca931765554cb39d0f12f4ca04ac1947edd13c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[15]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0016", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Hah!’ said Traddles, thoughtfully. ‘It does seem a wonder. I suppose it is, Copperfield, because there is no help for it?’", "sha256": "4f4ccb81cc1be7ad7c5c2456615df79898a1b598c9e30ce15fa6d509030b97af", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[16]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0017", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I suppose so,’ I replied with a smile, and not without a blush. ‘And because you have so much constancy and patience, Traddles.’", "sha256": "e45dbe026fe20688aee29b0ca6ef818138492c62adc3e558f6599e591a779952", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[17]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0018", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Dear me!’ said Traddles, considering about it, ‘do I strike you in that way, Copperfield? Really I didn’t know that I had. But she is such an extraordinarily dear girl herself, that it’s possible she may have imparted something of those virtues to me. Now you mention it, Copperfield, I shouldn’t wonder at all. I assure you she is always forgetting herself, and taking care of the other nine.’", "sha256": "7dceb0cbf5816d20fd625707c2ce44d486e9e4d8c2706d98c6e39c193bf1c6a8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[18]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0019", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is she the eldest?’ I inquired.", "sha256": "9dad4228f6fb73a70ba595b88a29b51731f2b47a4df3b72b2aca0989adaae96b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[19]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0020", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh dear, no,’ said Traddles. ‘The eldest is a Beauty.’", "sha256": "96f0e29c10ab41fe7f600bcb388887f76afcd9c5730fd439785cb1e3dadd686b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[20]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0021", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He saw, I suppose, that I could not help smiling at the simplicity of this reply; and added, with a smile upon his own ingenuous face:", "sha256": "2ed227782d254b3f896a678e626f63cbdca0c80547cce90b0d0f324b349812b1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[21]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0022", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Not, of course, but that my Sophy—pretty name, Copperfield, I always think?’", "sha256": "0413c42a277ff34486895e3fa91883dea3da2a9ec3364c3262b723cafd133312", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[22]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0023", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Very pretty!’ said I.", "sha256": "96fbc0aa31dfaf8846e1cda1136c456f4105a30171b0d51f3e241e15dfa5d365", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[23]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0024", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Not, of course, but that Sophy is beautiful too in my eyes, and would be one of the dearest girls that ever was, in anybody’s eyes (I should think). But when I say the eldest is a Beauty, I mean she really is a—’ he seemed to be describing clouds about himself, with both hands: ‘Splendid, you know,’ said Traddles, energetically. ‘Indeed!’ said I.", "sha256": "969fb4b1daad8914747fbea9d056db512f6bf8148ec9c1a4e53ff16d5d5d0c5e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[24]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0025", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh, I assure you,’ said Traddles, ‘something very uncommon, indeed! Then, you know, being formed for society and admiration, and not being able to enjoy much of it in consequence of their limited means, she naturally gets a little irritable and exacting, sometimes. Sophy puts her in good humour!’", "sha256": "5c4b8d48fb0e917ec6be5c873ca4fed7f355d9085c952beffb476d09de624e69", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[25]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0026", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is Sophy the youngest?’ I hazarded.", "sha256": "38a7645e29a7ac006c4103da28902a1b4f68d3436c367673dde14abfaf18bea9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[26]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0027", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh dear, no!’ said Traddles, stroking his chin. ‘The two youngest are only nine and ten. Sophy educates ‘em.’", "sha256": "4caadad7c16632323fc0757913c61aa60a2e35145d81f4d450adbc6cc152ba69", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[27]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0028", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The second daughter, perhaps?’ I hazarded.", "sha256": "d553af9fcf5f18501013b7223fa086bee41f137dc13a9cf63297dca8c4c998f1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[28]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0029", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No,’ said Traddles. ‘Sarah’s the second. Sarah has something the matter with her spine, poor girl. The malady will wear out by and by, the doctors say, but in the meantime she has to lie down for a twelvemonth. Sophy nurses her. Sophy’s the fourth.’", "sha256": "4f148eb157f204be171308bdaa7416d9fc958b53399ec69071d2584ea3f95353", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[29]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0030", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Is the mother living?’ I inquired.", "sha256": "93b155be8995a115516dabc96312381a7defdd642878742c610ede808a06fbc0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[30]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u036-b0031", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh yes,’ said Traddles, ‘she is alive. She is a very superior woman indeed, but the damp country is not adapted to her constitution, and—in fact, she has lost the use of her limbs.’", "sha256": "97e9f7becbed9f4e6dd29da1a92c10ca8ec547d4f81b36aaac5862067ed44226", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[41]/p[31]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
